description: The reserved bit 0x0010 is set in flags. 0x0002 (ENCRYPTED) and 0x000C (CIPHER_ID) are the highest allocated bits today, so 0x0010 is the next unassigned one. The CRC is recomputed because flags is part of the header the CRC covers. This pins down that the known-flags mask grew from 0x0003 to include CIPHER_ID, and that anything above it is still refused.
